method: Viewed all four full images with tools.view_image detail original; hashes calculated from the exact public files and matched the bound page visualization.originalDigest.

images.observation: Mutterkern A -> Tochterkern A-4 plus Alpha-Teilchen with four nucleons; both final rest masses are summed. Energy equation has m_before > m_after and a positive difference. Total-energy conservation, not-to-scale wording and the no-additional-radiation alpha-decay restriction are legible.
images.concern: No blocking physics or readability issue observed for this qualitative scope. Shapes are schematic; this is not a measured event or an assessment response.

images.observation: npn functional block separates green base drive from orange load control and explicitly attributes load energy to the supply. The lower model labels n-emitter, thin p-base and n-collector; off and suitable-drive/on states are distinguished.
images.concern: The overview does not supply a wired circuit, pnp polarities, carrier trajectories or safe assembly instructions. Those omissions bound its teaching-support role and must not be presented as completed experimental or independent learner evidence; no definite contradictory circuit topology is drawn.

images.observation: Conventional temperature direction is correctly stated as increasing to the left; red giants are at the upper right, white dwarfs at the lower left, and the main sequence slopes downward to the right.
images.concern: Numerical vertical ticks 10^-2, 1, 10^2 and 10^5 solar luminosities have approximately equal separations despite a final three-decade interval after two-decade intervals. Temperature ticks 30000, 10000, 6000, 4000 and 3000 K are likewise nearly equally spaced with no stated nonstandard scale. A square grid and numeric axes invite quantitative interpolation; no schematic/not-to-scale qualification resolves the ambiguity. Correct scale/drawing or explicit qualitative representation is needed before using it as an HRD data-placement support. This is a candidate subject-matter issue, not a human QA ruling.

images.observation: Three detection panels show a transit brightness dip, radial-velocity Doppler hints and a coronagraph-mask direct-image sketch. The central habitable-zone panel explicitly says not automatically life. The source panel names source, measurement error and confirmation, leading to a reasoned judgment.
images.concern: Method icons and the terrestrial-looking planet are schematic, not observations or demonstrations of habitability. No actual digital sources, line-shift measurement series or Earth-comparison data are supplied by this image. Evidence tasks must provide these separately; the picture's extra direct-imaging icon does not mandate a new standalone competence.

scopeLimit: No image was edited or approved for publication. This records visual inspection of local assets only; no browser, mobile device, real learner, source completeness or host acceptance check occurred.
